summary.lv: Luminor Bank meklē vecāko finanšu datu analītiķi treasury komandā, lai veidotu finanšu analīzes un datu pārskatus, atbalstot stratēģiskos biznesa lēmumus.
summary.en: Luminor Bank is hiring a Senior Financial Data Analyst for its treasury team to build financial analyses and data reports in support of strategic business decisions.
